sources_read: Selected saved artifacts and primary_policy.py inside user PRIVATE.zip

primary_20session_review.comparison_method: Read saved rational numerators/denominators; verify exact equality using Fraction; no market replay
primary_20session_review.interpretation: No 20-session improvement. These are normalized windows of the same connected evaluation series, not independently cash-reset monthly replays.

designer_assessment.design_issue: The four-LOW conjunction had zero support among the 50 actual planned Slot3 proposals. Recovery was causally dependent on a veto-generated token, so recovery never activated either.
designer_assessment.scope_of_failure: This fixed integration rule demonstrated no effect in the saved evaluation series. It does not prove that every head is useless or that Slot3 cannot be improved.
designer_assessment.nonregression_interpretation: All19 nonregression is not evidence of successful defense here: every funded identity, quantity and PnL was unchanged.
designer_assessment.not_a_data_availability_failure: All 50 scoped proposals had all four intelligence heads available.
designer_assessment.LOW_not_ground_truth_loser: MRET LOW35 is not a count of correctly detected realized losers; no new score-outcome join was performed in this review.
designer_assessment.accountability: Requiring all four LOW states and making recovery dependent on that trigger was the designer's ineffective integration choice, not an operator execution failure.

next_design_direction_proposed_only.first: Retain V5 as strategy parent and all current 20-session acceptance safeguards.
next_design_direction_proposed_only.second: Separate potential-winner preservation, realized-loss defense, and recovery activation instead of treating all four heads as interchangeable loser detectors.
next_design_direction_proposed_only.third: Define training-only support and activation/reachability checks before expensive full candidate replays; zero-support rules must not be reported as useful defense.
next_design_direction_proposed_only.fourth: Consider an independently testable recovery path rather than making all recovery conditional on a rare defense trigger. Any change needs a separate precommitted cycle.
next_design_direction_proposed_only.not_authorized: No automatic OR/3-of-4/threshold changes, no additional fit or D2/DR2 replay, no adoption.

NEXT_POLICY: Keep R1 fixed STOP and V5 champion. Await an explicitly requested new design; do not resume or retune R1.
